description: Sorcerer role builds for the Ascent Plan.

records.label: Fire and frost caster
records.summary: Ranged magic damage built around Firestorm feeding Hellfire. Keep your MP above 25 percent.

priorities: Reach the Specialty thresholds on your core skills first
Nezekan nodes for Hellfire, Firestorm and Wish of Concentration

rotation.reason: No proven Sorcerer rotation yet. Keep MP above 25 percent: Grace of Enhancement only adds PvE damage at 25 percent MP or more.

rows.name: Element Enhancement
rows.why: More Fire and Water damage for 10 s. A buff, kept in because it comes back with the other 60 s skills. Test it on its own key too.

rows.name: Delayed Explosion
rows.why: The target takes more from you for 4 s, then explodes.

rows.name: Fire Wall
rows.why: Burn over time on a 60 s cooldown.

rows.name: Blaze
rows.why: Only with Fire Mark, which your main attack applies.

mainAttack.name: Flame Arrow
mainAttack.why: Held with the macro key: MP back, Fire Mark, and it can reset Blaze.

rows.name: Bittercold Wind
rows.why: Short cooldown hit, a sure critical hit from skill Lv 12.

rows.name: Firestorm
rows.why: Shortest cooldown, so it sits last.

ownKeys.name: Hellfire
ownKeys.why: Charged: charge it by hand inside Element Enhancement. A macro only fires stage 1.

ownKeys.name: Defiance
ownKeys.why: Clears crowd control: you need it at a chosen moment.

levelNotes.text: Element Enhancement, Fire Wall and Cold Storm come back together, so each burst stacks every buff.
